snippet.title: DUSTWIRE - Teaser Trailer | PvPvE Extraction Shooter
snippet.description:
🎯 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5182080/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=teaser
🧪 Free Playtest in December: open the Steam page and press "Request Access"

The machines endure. So do you.

DUSTWIRE is a third-person PvPvE extraction shooter. Loot Scene City, fight hunter drones and machine bosses, and beat other squads to extraction - or lose everything you carried in. Solo, duo or trio.

🗓 Early Access: March 2, 2027
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/FhgFCspJG8
Follow on X: https://x.com/Strange_Picnic
Website: https://strangepicnic.com

#Dustwire #extractionshooter #indiegame
